title: SL(3,Z) is not Howson
summary: We give an explicit construction of two $2$-generated subgroups $H,K\leq \SL(3,\Z)$ whose intersection is not finitely generated. The construction takes place inside the standard parabolic subgroup $\Z^2\rtimes \SL(2,\Z)\leq \SL(3,\Z)$. The main point is to identify $H\cap K$ with the stabilizer of a point for an affine action of a free group on $\Z^2$, and then to prove, using the Schreier graph of this action, that this stabilizer is not finitely generated.
